profile_text.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a subsidiary of Amazon, a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, WA. Amazon reported revenue of $716,924,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, and trades on public markets under the ticker AMZN.

AWS offers Amazon SageMaker, which the company describes as a unified development environment for data, analytics, and machine learning. The platform combines tools for model development, generative AI, data processing, and SQL analytics within a single interface called SageMaker Unified Studio. It includes capabilities the company identifies as HyperPod, JumpStart, and MLOps, along with Amazon Q Developer for natural language assistance across tasks such as model building, SQL query generation, and data pipeline creation. SageMaker also provides a lakehouse architecture integrating Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift, federated query access to third-party data sources via Apache Iceberg-compatible tools, and governance features including Amazon SageMaker Catalog for access control, data classification, toxicity detection, and responsible AI policies. AWS additionally offers AWS Bedrock, a managed foundation model API service that includes IAM integration, VPC support, model evaluation tools, and a component called AgentCore for agent orchestration.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or patent filings appear in the held facts for this entry.
